attempts.url: no OpenAPI 3.x endpoint; OCL serves Swagger 2.0 from drf-yasg

notes: Full coverage of the Open Concept Lab API (build 2.3.201), converted from the Swagger 2.0 document OCL generates from its live URL configuration and serves at /swagger/?format=openapi, committed verbatim as upstream.json — 1966 operations over 968 paths (concepts, mappings, sources, collections, orgs, users, repos, expansions, exports, bulk import, pins, subscriptions, client configs) and 84 component schemas. Replaces a 17 KiB hand-authored spec covering a handful of endpoints. NOTE: the upstream reuses operationIds across routes (drf-yasg names them per view, not per route), which OpenAPI forbids; the 1526 duplicated ids are regenerated from method+path in openapi.json and the upstream id is preserved on each operation as x-upstream-operation-id.
